searchText: What channel do ACD calls show up on these days? cc <@642887713246150666> Channel - https://www.youtube.com/@EthereumProtocol Last ACDE call - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SmcMwdHZqg8 Why don't the ACD calls show up in the Videos tab of the channel? The EOF/EIP-4844 calls show up, but not ACDC or ACDE. Is the ACDC call from yesterday available anywhere yet? Ah, they show up under the Live tab, not Videos tab. That is annoying. Probably, we should make a playlist. I have a proposal that may get zero traction: why not call just all ACD and simply have differently oriented agendas? devs from both camps are wellcome and often needed in all calls. Unless it's something pretty technical on the EVM or about forkchoice, we often times need imput from both sides. I find this need of separation silly The first part of the ACDC call was accidently streamed to a different link and can be found here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z-0z5-7hGvo ~~The full recording will be uploaded.~~ A silly oversight from my side, the complete recording of **ACDC meeting 101** (aka CL meeting 101) is available on this link. https://youtu.be/Z-0z5-7hGvo It was streamed to two different links simultaneously and I assumed, it went out in two parts 🙂 we need to modify the devp2p protocol as well, right? I think there's value in having some separation of "default agenda" (and facilitator 😛 !), but I've been calling them both "ACD" for short Reflecting on the planning process for Shanghai/Capella, and the discussions around fork planning for withdrawals/EOF/4844/1153/BLS/etc., I'd like to propose we use Ethereum Magicians a bit more proactively to have those types of discussions. I've put up a proposal on the forum directly fleshing out the details: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/proposal-network-upgrade-meta-threads/12552 Will add to the ACDE agenda next week to discuss 😄 we do but implementers seem to just be inferring changes based on the EIP If I have any other social network related to Ethereum I won't work anymore... I'm just saying I'd like the behavior of opcodes to change as little as possible over time. This isn't related directly to EIP-6049.
